episodes.title: THE MOST WANTED WOMAN IN AFRICA
episodes.description:
It’s the morning of March 17th, 2000, and this woman… Credonia Mwerinde, is about to lock 600 of her followers inside a huge Church building on her compound and set them on fire! The doors were locked and the windows were sealed! She orchestrated the largest cult mass murder in modern history. 

This is the story of how one woman ended the lives of over 1,000 people just because she wanted to protect her authority and reputation! Hmm! Fasten your seatbelts because this is going to be a rollercoaster ride. 

Stay tuned for the full details.
